title: Toma S NDE 6633
content: I ask that you remember I was only three years old at the time of my near death experience. The only reason I remember and asked my mum was because of my recent dreams. Ever since birth I've been depressed. At age three, I committed suicide. They used to have me on a time-release medicine. One day my mother came to check on me because of the fact I hadn't woken up from my nap after she gave me my meds. I remember the feeling of relaxing at last. I felt free but trapped. My lungs had almost stopped pumping air, so I wasn't breathing properly. Eventually I stopped breathing all together. By the time the ambulance was on its way to the hospital, I was close to death. When we were finally in the hospital, I died. I was dead for a total of six to fourteen minutes. After they brought me back, thanks to shocks, they had to have me on life-support for a few weeks. When they brought me back and the nurse asked me what happened with the medicine patch I had, I told her I ate it so I would fall asleep and never wake up. I wanted to be with ‘them.’ I still don't know who ‘them’ are. I honestly don't think anyone does. My mum never told me about this until I asked her about it a few months back. The only reason I ever found out was because of strange dreams I kept having about it. These dreams always showed the same symbol. After I told her about the dreams, she closed up and it took a little while before she told me it was something that actually happened. Ever since I can't stop thinking about it or even drawing the symbol.

arrival.other_being_detail: The experiencer refers to wanting to be with 'them' but states they still do not know who 'them' are.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: At age three, the experiencer reports eating a time-release medicine patch to 'fall asleep and never wake up.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Narrative focuses on medical crisis/death duration and later discovery via recurring dreams and a repeated symbol, without describing canonical NDE stages (OBE/tunnel/light/realm/encounters/boundary).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experiencer reports recurring dreams about the event featuring 'the same symbol' and a persistent urge to think about and draw the symbol; they also state they wanted to be with 'them' but do not know who 'them' are.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I remember the feeling of relaxing at last. I felt free but trapped.” “I was dead for a total of six to fourteen minutes.” “I told her I ate it so I would fall asleep and never wake up. I wanted to be with ‘them.’ I still don't know who ‘them’ are.” “These dreams always showed the same symbol.”
